role: Inspect recorded windows only; no simulation rollout, Q updates, validation or test
case_filter: All cases with timeline_category collision_after_clearance_only_stop, separately for each original fixed controller
measurements: Original ray directions at first clearance-only STOP, pre-event request names, original frame times, recorded pose/motion projection and window duration
limitations: Reduced diagnostic snapshots omit target and full sensor/armed/manual/battery metadata; exact original Q-feature/action-mask reconstruction is impossible from these snapshots alone.
Do not synthesize omitted fields, reconstruct complete historical training or infer range rates from rotating body-relative rays.
Windows are at most ten transitions and are deliberately selected around a known event; descriptive counts are not a new performance benchmark or population causal attribution.
